Name: Pose Studio
Author: Pose Studio
Description: Run Pose Studio (the Blockbench plugin for posing Minecraft Bedrock screenshots) from your Stream Deck: captures, cameras, toggles, time and weather. Turn on Pose Studio ▸ More ▸ Stream Deck Link in Blockbench.

Actions.Name: Capture Screenshot
Actions.Tooltip: Hides the interface and saves the Minecraft window to the Pose Studio folder in Pictures.

Actions.Name: Capture Entities Only
Actions.Tooltip: Saves the players and mobs on their own (and the passes picked in Entity Shot Options).

Actions.Name: Camera
Actions.Tooltip: Switches to the next, the previous or a numbered camera. The key shows the camera's name and lights up while it's the active one.

Actions.Name: Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Sync Game Camera, the Camera POV view, or the Minecraft connection. The key is lit while it's on.

Actions.Name: Time & Weather
Actions.Tooltip: Sets the scene's time of day and weather.

Actions.Name: Run Action
Actions.Tooltip: Runs anything from the Pose Studio menu: Drop to Ground, Compare with Game, Add Camera…

Actions.Name: Switch To
Actions.Tooltip: Brings Blockbench (or Minecraft) to the front.
